answer: To suppress Sybil attacks in an agent economy monitoring an ocean estuary and cedar timberland, nodes register identities via cryptographic proof-of-burn. Every device, including each telemetry lantern, must destroy native tokens by transmitting them to an unspendable address. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of forfeited financial capital per fake identity. However, permanent token burning creates a regressive economic barrier that excludes low-capital honest agents.
